correctness.rationale: The 126 transmitted multisets are weak compositions of 5 into 5 parts; two have a shared deletion descendant iff their L1 distance is two. Thus codes are independent sets in the unit-transfer graph, or size-26 cliques of its complement. Source verify_n5.cpp uses a greedy proper coloring of every candidate subgraph: prefix color numbers give a rigorous upper bound on later clique extension. Independent C++17 code implemented the vertex compositions in reverse lexicographic ordering, edges from L1>2, and a separate coloring-branch enumeration; it visited 93,475,251 nodes, obtained exactly six size-26 cliques, and matched these to the six distinct checksum-zero classes among all 120 label permutations. For each class, independent deletion shadow enumeration found exactly all 70 received profiles. Any clique size>=27 would contain at least 27 distinct 26-subcliques, so the six-class census excludes it. The root-of-unity filter gives |C_f|=(binom(9,4)+4)/5=26. Affine checksum relabeling yields stabilizer size20, S5 orbit size6; exact positive-coordinate profile (5):5,(3,1,1):10,(2,2,1):10,(1^5):1 gives 5+30+30+5=70 shadows. The finite census is exhaustive for q=n=5 only; no other-parameter extrapolation.
